budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager read a memo on FY 2023 budget priorities, including continued police and Fire/EMS staffing plans and building maintenance needs; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: my budget recommendation will continue to include the 10 year statting plan for the police department

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital Planning request forms go to departments, due in October; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: we will be sending out the request forms to the departments and they will need to be submitted by october 14

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Finance Committee and School Committee workshop on Chapter 70 school funding was scheduled; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: the finance committee will be cohosting a workshop with the school committee on chapter 70 funding

budget_items.what_was_recorded: MassDEP reported no additional LUST funds for site-specific work for now; MassDevelopment funding not available until next year; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: unfortunately for now it does not appear additional funds will be available for site specific activities

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The proposed demolition delay article sets a fine of three hundred dollars per violation; a resident cited the same $300 fine in Norton and Mendon bylaws; the Chair opposed a money fine.
budget_items.quote: shall be subject to a fine or penalty in the amount of three hundred dollars ($300.00,)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Chair Alonzo objected that the article would require applicants to spend money on a building they wish to tear down; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: you are telling them to spend money on a building that they are requesting to tear down.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The policy fixes the maximum amount each participant can earn at $1,500 under the statute.
budget_items.quote: the maximum amount each participant can earn is fixed at $1,500 for the senior tax work-off program

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The policy sets gross household income limits of $50,000 for a single person and $75,000 for a married person.
budget_items.quote: gross household income not exceeding $50,000 for a single person or $75,000 for married person

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Participant earnings are subject to OBRA withholding of 7.5% if not receiving a qualifying pension.
budget_items.quote: are also subject to obra (7.5%) of earnings, if the participant is not receiving a pension
